Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in its initial analysis by incorrectly identifying Norris Bradbury as the director of the Los Alamos Laboratory during the development of the first atomic bomb. The Planner stated, "Given Water Boiler places us at Los Alamos, and the first atomic bomb was in 1945, the lab director in 1945 (Norris Bradbury) directed the project." This is historically inaccurate; J. Robert Oppenheimer was the director of Los Alamos from 1942 to 1945, while Norris Bradbury succeeded him in 1946. This premature and incorrect conclusion caused the conversation to oscillate between Oppenheimer and Bradbury for several steps, requiring multiple redundant searches to correct the initial misunderstanding.
